summary: D01 keeps 30 of its 46 nodes unchanged and changes 16, with no split, merge or retirement (so it needs no save alias). (1) A6 coupling: heavy_plough, horse_collar, rice_champa and sugar_refining are practitioner crafts that the Age-based classification rule (ADR-029 §8 R1) placed in the Agriculture subtree; they move to the trunk (D-044 §15), so entering A6 no longer requires the research stage. heavy_plough's prerequisite changes from the Han cast-iron mouldboard (iron_mouldboard <- cast_iron) to the causal European set plough_ard AND iron_bloomery AND wheel_solid: its closure falls from 28 nodes / 59,470 RP to 19 / 27,570 and the A6 AI core goal becomes all-trunk. (2) Regional alternatives without new clicks: orchard and terrace accept root-crop farmers; beer accepts any domesticated cereal; pig is domesticated from the dog root, not behind sheep and goats (China); sugar crystallisation needs cane growing and boiling vessels, not fermentation and distillation; Tull's drill rests on the ard and horse traction, not the Norfolk rotation; cereal_domesticated is renamed for what it is (wheat and barley). (3) Causal gaps closed: selective_breeding needs livestock; drip irrigation needs irrigation. (4) Cost consistency: material 2.0 on cereal_cultivation, cereal_domesticated and maize (above tin bronze, while rice, millet, sorghum and tubers score 0.0) is re-scored to 0.0. (5) Five new nodes: cotton_cultivation (trunk, an independently domesticated fibre crop) and, in the subtree, agricultural_chemistry (science) -> chemical_fertilizer (application; mineral inputs identified by D11), scientific_plant_breeding (genetics -> hybrid and HYV breeding) and farm_machinery (threshers, reapers, iron ploughs: the missing step between Tull and the tractor). The subtree now starts at A7 and still holds 15 nodes (14 finite). Farming yield depends on research today only through the first activity.farming member; every other agricultural effect is deferred with a named owner. Replies to the lanes that wrote to D01 are in crossLaneRequests: D04's thermodynamics edge on refrigeration is accepted as an integration override, and mechanised_agriculture is re-dated to its emergence (1892/1904 CE) for D09's tank edge.

A peasant and smith's craft adopted across northern Europe centuries before its universities: it does not causally need organized scholarship. It sat in the Agriculture subtree only because ADR-029 §8 rule R1 classed every A6+ node by domain, which forces a node into a subtree against D-044 §15 and ties the A6 CORE fact to the research stage. Its old prerequisite was the Han cast-iron plough, a separate regional development.
